summary: Iter20 fully verified. BACKEND (8/8 pytest passing): (a) GET /api/schedule/{date}/suggest-lines (plural) is removed → returns 404 as required; singular /suggest-line still returns 200. (b) Multi-step undo stack: history starts at 0 after fresh generate; after 5 different mutations (mark-absent, fill-shortages, set-disabled-activities on non-support line E2, close-line, adjust) history grows to 5 with correct shape (action, snapshot_at, line_configs, absent_person_ids, overrides, unassigned_keys, required_overrides, assignments, closures, closed_line_keys, disabled_activities). (c) After 7 mutations history caps at exactly 5 via $push $slice:-5. (d) POST /undo pops most recent snapshot: after fill+adjust+close-line, one undo removes close-line (closed_line_keys no longer contains X-Smart) and history length drops by 1; draining to 0 then next undo returns 400 'Nothing to undo'. (e) close-line + adjust preserves closed_line_keys (previously wiped by /adjust). (f) set-disabled-activities value preserved across subsequent adjust. (g) mark-absent + undo restores absent_person_ids. Also confirmed: generate_schedule (POST /api/schedule) now preserves history/closures — test suite had to explicitly DELETE the schedule between tests. FRONTEND: suggest-lines-btn ('What else can we run?') fully removed from DOM. suggest-start-line-btn present with new label 'Suggest another line to run', clicking opens a dialog. Undo button initially disabled with no badge, after 3 mutations shows badge '3', clicking triggers Sonner toast 'Undone: Mark absent · Hetal Vankar', decrements 3→2→1→0, then disables again. Mobile 400x800: mobile-suggest-start-line-btn visible in Unassigned card; undo-btn also visible in header.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~2004 lines and every mutating endpoint duplicates the snapshot+$push $slice:-5 pattern. Consider extracting a `history_service.record(date, shift, sched_doc, action)` helper to DRY the 8 call sites (adjust, fill-shortages, late-arrival, mark-absent, set-disabled-activities, close-line, reopen-line, start-line).

The undo endpoint restores the full snapshot but does NOT re-derive totals from the assignments (it just restores the persisted totals). If a future migration ever adds new schedule fields (e.g. metadata), older snapshots taken before the migration will leave those new fields untouched on restore. Consider defensively re-running _recompute_totals(sched) at the end of undo.
MAX_HISTORY = 5 is a magic number — could be lifted to env/config so ops can tune.
BoardPage.jsx is now ~2033 lines and continues to be a monolith; the Undo header, Unassigned row, Suggestions dialog, and cell edit modals could be split into sibling components.
seed_data_creation: Test schedules for 2026-10-15 (pytest) and 2026-10-16 (playwright) — both DELETEd during teardown.
